title: Handle to Small
text: Handle to Small. Handle is a bit small for my hands and I have found that it becomes difficult to use. I think if the mug was taller and the handle larger this would have been a great mug but the mug is a little large in diameter and the coffee tends to slash over if your are not careful.

product_metadata.title: Doctor Who Disappearing TARDIS Coffee Mug - Add Hot Liquid and Watch The TARDIS Move From London to the Stars - Comes in a Fun Gift Box
features: The iconic time machine / spacecraft sits in disguise on an English street. Add hot liquid, and it disappears, only to reappear in a far far away galaxy on the other side of the mug!
12 oz. mug. Heat changing mugs are microwave safe, but not dishwasher safe. Hand wash only. Don't soak.
